summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test via str.startswith(ref, self); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace); the IPython key-completion hook now returns dir(self.uri). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS and RDF closed membership, and non-URIRef negatives. Nothing was run, per instructions; changes were verified by reading only. No commits made.
